priorDecision.minimumMissingWitness: Supply a complete Director-determined useful question answer and an independent substantive task, each tied to actual source facts and recipient/faith context, with specified outcome limits and protected/uncertain/interrupt/repeat/conflict/lifecycle behavior; demonstrate actual acquired Cleric and Wizard actors and fully paid reversible states. The missing evidence is the instantiated operational contract and positive encounters, not a universal deity genealogy or a success percentage.

requiredContent: A complete question outcome contract: actual declared faith/recipient relation (without inventing deity ontology), exact useful fact sought, evidence/knowledge availability and disclosure eligibility, answer precision and an actually specified uncertainty/protection result. A generic information comparison is not permission for this spell to reveal everything.

A substantive task outcome contract: exact permitted changes, targets/geometry, actual body/item/source/resource inputs, resolution and any resistance, physical versus magical aftermath, and once-only termination/suppression/repetition/conflict handling. Director-determined result is real source permission, but no automatic or universal outcome follows.

Two complete actual acquired rank9 casting witnesses across Cleric and Wizard: question and task, ordinary Action/26RP base and class-adjusted costs/cadence, components, legal chronology, meaningful adverse branches and full before/after identity/resource/custody states. These do not exist in the prior prepared conference.
